topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: You ever have one of those days where you turn a corner and the world feels like it's mocking you? Got a call today. My kid's school. Turns out, the teacher's name I got shook hands with at the orientation? A name from my past. The same one who pushed me to read beyond my grade, to dream bigger, even when I thought there wasn't much worth dreaming about. Funny how the world works. Should've seen it coming, I guess. My old man always said, "What goes around, comes around." I just never thought it'd circle back to haunt me in a place I thought was safe. Gotta figure out how to handle this. Can't let the kid see the weight of the past dragging me down. Not when she's looking up to me for the future.
